2.why: Source pitch 2 (5.11d, 35m): lunge to ledge, then easy left-facing corner finishes on Smoke Break Ledge, where the pitch ends
2.text: The belay is on Smoke Break Ledge, reached by an easy left-facing corner after the lunge to the ledge.

5.why: Source pitch 5 (10-, 100ft): pass the first anchors (rap anchors) to bolts farther left that set up the next belay
5.text: The belay is at the bolts set farther left, beyond the rappel anchors you pass near the end of the pitch.

7.why: Source pitch 7: traverse left, up corner to the anchor just below the summit; summit is a short scramble
7.text: The belay is at a bolted anchor just under the summit, with a short scramble remaining to the top.

P2.why: Source P2: aid flared seam past one bolt, final 5.6 move to the anchor; mantel-onto-ledge only from a photo caption, so removed
P2.text: The belay is at the anchor reached just after the last 5.6 move above the flared seam.

P4.why: Source P4 (Skywalker Traverse): climb the ramp up and left to a spot below the double corner; 'ledge' detail dropped as not clearly the belay
P4.text: The belay is at the top of the ramp that climbs up and left, directly below the obvious double corner.
